text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hanshin J.F...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, check out this crowd. The
atmosphere is
totally different from her
debut. Is today special
or something?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Either way, we gotta cheer
as loud
as we can! With a crowd this
size, I'm worried
Yukino might get kinda
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: OH MY STARS, I CAN'T DO THIIIIS!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But this feels totally diff'rent from my
debut!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And I'm not just talk'n 'bout the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Guess it's time for me to go win this
thing!

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. I'll show you what happens
when you
underestimate me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ev'ryone's so confident... They're practic'lly shin'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Can I actually keep up?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm hoping she'll be able to calm down a
bit there.
But that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Haha. What's with that face?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu?! What're you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer sent me tickets for the
bullet train
and asked me t'come!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you did that... for me? But what
about—

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I just happened t'have the day off, so I
was able
t'rush right over!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay. As long as you're not miss'n
out on
figure skat'n practice... Thanks for
com'n all this
way.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Sure, but I've also got a bone t'pick with you! How come you weren't the one send'n me an invitation?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You're trying t'do this all on your own,
aren't
you? Well, don't you dare forget,
you've got a
lifelong friend and
supporter in me!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I may not know anything about rac'n,
but I know
all about you!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So I know that you'll be okay! You're
gonna be
awesome out there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I know you're not
gonna slack
off, knowing I'm out there
watch'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You're right about that! You
know...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you here was just the pick-me-up
I
needed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And since you've come all the way out
here, I
can't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righty-o!
